definitions.short: (only in plural collective) exit , i.e. (geographical) boundary , or (figuratively) deliverance , (actively) source
definitions.full: H8444. totsaah [ תּוֺצָאָה ] noun feminine outgoing, extremity, source (?), escape ; only plural; chiefly P and late; — absolute תוֺצָאוֺת Psa 68:21 ; construct תוֺצְאוֺת Prov 4:23 + Josh 18:19 Qr (Kt תוצאותיו ); תּוֺצְאֹת Num 34:8 ; Ezek 48:30 ; תֹּצְאוֺת Josh 15:4 2 t.; suffix תּוֺצְאֹתָיו Num 34:4 3 t.; תֹּצְאֹתָיו Josh 15:7-8 t. + 16:3 Qr (Kt תצאתו ); תּוֺצְאוֺתָם 1Chr 5:16 ; — 1 outgoing, extremity of border of territory Josh 16:3 ; 17:18 (both J E), elsewhere P: Num 34:4-5 , 8 , 9 , 12 ; Josh 15:4 , 7 , 11 ; 16:8 ; 17:9 ; 18:12 , 14 , 19 ; 19:14 , 22 , 20 , 33 ; outskirts of city Ezek 48:20 , compare 1Chr 5:16 . 2 ׳ת חַיִּים Prov 4:23 (? read מוֺצְאוֺת ) sources of life. 3 ת ׳לַמָּוֶת Psa 68:21 escapes from (literally for , i.e. in view of ) death .
